reads_as: Giant 'CS 101' course-badge with a smug genius face cropped into the corner — a slick 'learn this' card.
layout_map: Dark charcoal grid-paper background fills frame. Headline block sits left-center across cells 5-6-9-10: huge white slab-serif 'CS' (caps, ~x60-200, baseline ~y110) butts against a red rounded rectangle holding white '101' (red box ~x210-380, y55-130), so the two read as one lockup. Below it a thin white lowercase subtitle 'computer science for ret...' runs along baseline ~y160 (cells 9-10-11), trailing off behind the face. A grinning man (Étienne/'genius' meme crop) occupies the right ~28% of frame in cells 8 and 12, face center ~x980,y90, suit-and-tie shoulders filling lower right to the edge.
why_it_works: The oversized course-code badge promises a complete syllabus in one image while the smug face injects personality and an in-joke.
mimic_for: an authoritative '101' / fundamentals explainer that covers a whole field in one video
title: 100+ Computer Science Concepts Explained

reads_as: The Java coffee-cup logo dead-center on dark grid with a red '100 SECONDS OF' banner and a tiny crying face peeking from the corner.
layout_map: Dark charcoal grid background. A red horizontal banner caps the top edge (cells 1-4, y0-45) with white text: bold '100' then thinner 'SECONDS OF' (~x300-560, baseline ~y30). The blue-and-red Java steaming-coffee logo is the hero, centered in cells 6-7-10-11, logo center ~x560,y330, filling roughly the middle third. A small distressed/crying child face is cropped into the top-right corner (cell 4 into 8, face center ~x1180,y90), bleeding off the right edge as the emotional tell.
why_it_works: Clean centered logo gives instant topic ID; the '100 seconds' banner sets the fast-format promise and the crying face signals the 'haters' angle.
mimic_for: a fast single-technology explainer (the '100 seconds of X' format) with a hint of controversy
title: Java for the Haters in 100 Seconds

reads_as: 'Linux 101' in a serif title with an orange swoosh underline beside a chubby Arch-Linux wojak — nerdy fundamentals with a meme.
layout_map: Dark charcoal grid background. Top-left headline: large white serif 'Linux' (caps L, ~x40-300, baseline ~y90) with an orange paint-swoosh sweeping under and right beneath it (~y110-130). Below, a red rounded rectangle holds white slab '101' (box ~x110-300, y130-200, cells 5-9). Right half is a fat wojak/soyjak meme character (cell 8-12), face center ~x1010,y75, wearing a teal 'archlinux' t-shirt whose chest logo sits ~x980,y230, body bleeding off the bottom-right.
why_it_works: The badge-style title signals a complete primer while the bloated Arch wojak is an instant insider meme that rewards the niche audience.
mimic_for: a fundamentals/primer on a developer tool or OS, with a self-aware community in-joke
title: 100+ Linux Things you Need to Know

reads_as: Blue DeepSeek whale logo + 'r1' next to 'FIRST LOOK' in red, with a wide-eyed shocked Sam-Altman face on the right — breaking AI news.
layout_map: Dark charcoal grid background. Left-center: blue DeepSeek whale logo (~x60-230,y70-150) immediately followed by huge white lowercase 'r1' (~x250-470, baseline ~y150, cells 5-6). Below that, bold red caps 'FIRST LOOK' on baseline ~y230 (cells 9-10). A small black 'CODE REPORT' badge sits bottom-left corner (~x30,y290). Right ~30% of frame is a shocked open-mouthed man's face (Sam Altman crop) in cells 8 and 12, face center ~x1050,y150, holding a mic at chin, shoulders bleeding off the right/bottom edge.
why_it_works: The shocked face reads as 'this changes everything' breaking news while the logo+version lockup nails exactly which model dropped.
mimic_for: a breaking-news 'first look' at a newly released tool/model with a stunned-reaction tone
title: This free Chinese AI just crushed OpenAI's $200 o1 model...

reads_as: Two glowing CPU chips facing off — blue Intel chip vs neon-pink Apple M1 die — with a white 'VS' bolt between them.
layout_map: Black tech-grid background with faint blue rim glow. Red banner caps the top edge (cells 1-4, y0-45): white bold '100' + thin 'SECONDS OF' + a chip glyph (~x300-620, baseline ~y30). Left hero: a glowing Intel CPU package with blue 'intel' label, chip center ~x300,y360 (cells 9-13-ish, lower-left quadrant). Center: bold white 'VS' at ~x560,y360. Right hero: a magenta/pink-glowing Apple M1 die with 'M1 8-core CPU' label, chip center ~x900,y360 (cells 11-12-15-16). Both chips emit colored bloom on the dark floor.
why_it_works: Two glowing chips with a VS bolt instantly frames a head-to-head benchmark, and the color split (blue vs pink) tells the rivalry at a glance.
mimic_for: a head-to-head comparison/benchmark of two competing products or technologies
title: How a CPU Works in 100 Seconds // Apple Silicon M1 vs Intel i9
